value: At the Warden’s Cage, Olum chooses the spirit world rather than risk giving his captors the secret. Akama helps him die among his brothers. Illidan’s suspicion then demands another act: Akama reports a genuine betrayal by Kael’thas, diverting attention from the Ashtongue plot. Olum’s sacrifice leaves no triumph in its wake. It preserves the cover at the cost of one of the plan’s oldest companions.
